clue.text: Steps a person can take to make getting up easier

definitions.text: Steps a person can take to make getting up easier

parts.words: Steps a person can take to make getting up easier
parts.note: reads like advice for rising from bed, but describes moving stairs that carry you up a floor

explanation.surface: Self-help advice on easing the misery of getting out of bed in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase is literally a set of steps that makes going upstairs effortless.

clue.text: Crushes a member of the family

explanation.surface: Someone flattens a relative.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as STEPS ON, the answer means treads on, i.e. crushes; as one word it is a relative by marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: To tread on something squashes it; a spouse's child from an earlier union is a relation by marriage.

clue.text: Woman covering for a worm

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name
a lid is a covering for a pot or box

explanation.surface: A woman stands in for a worm, or covers for one.
explanation.definitionFit: An annelid is a segmented creature of the earthworm and leech family.

clue.text: Stagger like a heavyweight before his knock-out

parts.note: as means like, in the same way
a ton is a very heavy weight

indicators.note: knocking the word his out of shape rearranges its letters

explanation.surface: A heavyweight boxer staggers before being knocked out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knock-out' rearranges HIS into ISH; 'before' simply sets the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: To stagger someone is to amaze or stun them.

clue.text: Concerned with Greek and French compunction

parts.note: re means concerning, as in a letter heading
et is the French word for and

explanation.surface: A Greek and a Frenchman share a feeling of remorse.
explanation.definitionFit: Compunction is a pang of conscience, a sorry feeling about something done.

clue.text: A telling characteristic? Far from it!

definitions.text: A telling characteristic? Far from it!

parts.words: A telling characteristic? Far from it!
parts.note: a quality that is the opposite of telling, i.e. a disposition to keep things to oneself

explanation.surface: Someone denies that a trait is revealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being disinclined to speak freely is the reverse of a tendency to tell all.

clue.text: One writer will appear in red but not green

indicators.note: the following pieces show up inside the word red

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A writer is published in a left-wing paper rather than an environmentalist one.
explanation.walkthrough: The colours suggest politics, but 'not green' is the definition: fruit no longer unripe.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit that has matured is no longer unripe.

clue.text: Coaches among others show a certain circumspection

indicators.note: among puts the coaches inside the word for others

parts.note: the rest means the others
a string of railway coaches makes a train

explanation.surface: Sports coaches mixing with others behave carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is self-control, holding back out of caution.

clue.text: A man withdrawn before receiving discharge

indicators.note: receiving means the word for before takes the next piece inside

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
to emit is to discharge

explanation.surface: A man retreats before being discharged from the army.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit, especially a religious recluse, is a man who has withdrawn from the world.

clue.text: A central principle, not an opening communication!

definitions.text: A central principle, not an opening communication!

parts.words: A central principle, not an opening communication!
parts.note: split, the word suggests a message about something that opens locks, but it means the governing idea

explanation.surface: A core idea, someone insists, rather than an introductory message.
explanation.definitionFit: A keynote is the main theme or underlying idea of a speech or policy.

clue.text: Divided about design for dress

indicators.note: about means the word for divided goes around the other piece

parts.note: rent means torn apart, divided
aim means intention or design

explanation.surface: A divided committee debates a design for a dress.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an old literary word for clothing.

clue.text: Commute — and please walk

indicators.note: to commute is to change or exchange, so these letters are switched around

explanation.surface: A commuter is invited to walk to work.
explanation.definitionFit: A seafront promenade is a level walk for strolling.

clue.text: Cleared out and lay down

indicators.note: out means the letters of cleared are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone cleared out the room and lay down.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay down a rule or state formally is to announce it.

clue.text: Latin and so on could well be abbreviated

definitions.text: Latin and so on could well be abbreviated

parts.words: Latin and so on could well be abbreviated
parts.note: the Latin phrase for 'and so on' is usually shortened to three letters with a full stop

explanation.surface: A remark that Latin and similar subjects might be cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase meaning 'and other things' is normally written as the abbreviation etc.

clue.text: Poles and Danes getting agitated about nothing

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around the next piece
agitated letters are stirred up and rearranged

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Poles and Danes get worked up over nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting agitated' turns DANES into ANDES, which goes 'about' O.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrodes are the positive and negative terminals of a cell or battery.

clue.text: Shame quiet guys into a strike

indicators.note: into means the quiet guys are put inside the word for strike

parts.note: to bat is to hit or strike
sh is the call for quiet
men means guys

explanation.surface: Quiet men are shamed into going on strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Embarrassment or mortification is a state of shame.

clue.text: Pupils of a school accepting south and north Europeans

indicators.note: accepting means the pupils take in the next letter

parts.note: Etonians are pupils of Eton College, a famous English public school

explanation.surface: A school takes in pupils from south and north Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and north' looks like a second compass point to insert, but 'north Europeans' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: People of the Baltic republic of Estonia are natives of northern Europe.

clue.text: Visit returned by a girl in a lustrous coat

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a girl

indicators.note: returned means the word for visit is read backwards

parts.note: to call is to pay a visit

explanation.surface: A girl in a glossy coat pays a return visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellac is a resin varnish that gives wood a glossy finish.

clue.text: Favour the man pressing a suit

explanation.surface: A man presses for a favour while pushing a lawsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pressing a suit' sounds like ironing but means pursuing a case in court.
explanation.definitionFit: To back an idea is to favour it; a lawyer who argues a client's case in court presses the lawsuit.

clue.text: Reluctance to throw over the head

indicators.note: in a down answer, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to shy is to fling or throw
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: Unwilling to throw the ball over someone's head.
explanation.walkthrough: NESS, a headland, appears in place names such as Loch Ness and Dungeness.
explanation.definitionFit: Timidity, a disinclination to come forward, is a form of reluctance.

clue.text: Prated about leave

indicators.note: about means the letters of prated are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone prattled on about going on leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To go away from a place is to leave it.

clue.text: Not paid for dressing the guinea-fowl

indicators.note: dressing up the letters puts them in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A guinea-fowl is dressed for the table without being paid for.
explanation.definitionFit: Pintado is another name for the guinea-fowl, from the Portuguese for painted.

clue.text: This Scottish scientist raced farm animals

parts.note: ran means raced
kine is an old plural of cow

explanation.surface: A Scottish scientist races cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: William Rankine was a Glasgow engineer and physicist who gave his name to a temperature scale.

clue.text: A glass ship rigged fore-and-aft

explanation.surface: A drink in a glass aboard a sailing vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall glass for sherry or beer has this name, as does a sailing vessel with fore-and-aft sails on two or more masts.

clue.text: He's a high-flier — a high-minded individual

definitions.text: He's a high-flier — a high-minded individual

parts.words: He's a high-flier — a high-minded individual
parts.note: a man's name that begins with a sea eagle and sounds like the word for serious and sincere

explanation.surface: A man described as both a high achiever and a person of principle.
explanation.walkthrough: An ERNE is a sea eagle, the high-flier; the full name sounds like 'earnest', meaning high-minded.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernest is a man's given name, punning on being sincere and serious.

clue.text: Soldiers at enlistment making response

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
joining is what recruits do when they enlist

explanation.surface: Soldiers answer back as they sign up.
explanation.definitionFit: A rejoinder is a reply, so rejoining is answering back.

clue.text: This building worker is over forward

parts.note: a man can mean a workman, a worker

indicators.note: over means the word is turned over, reading backwards

parts.note: on means forward, onward

explanation.surface: A building worker is over-forward with his manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A mansion is a large, stately house.

clue.text: Some eggs at an ice-cream factory are diabolical!

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Eggs at an ice-cream factory are said to be dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'factory are diabolical' as the definition, but 'factory are' is surface padding; only 'diabolical' means the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilish or fiendish things are worthy of the Devil himself.

clue.text: There are no signs indicating they are on the steps

indicators.note: indicating is taken loosely as showing the letters of no signs in another order

explanation.surface: A remark that no signs point to something on a staircase.
explanation.definitionFit: The rounded front edges of stair treads are called nosings.

clue.text: How a ferryman assumes control?

explanation.surface: A ferryman seizes command.
explanation.walkthrough: A ferryman literally carries people across the water; the phrase also means assumes command.
explanation.definitionFit: A ferryman ferries passengers across; to assume command of something is to seize control.
